act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 33 (Delhi) + Delhi Dept. of Revenue operative rate
source.quoted_text: Delhi Dept. of Revenue (official) — Gift Deed: 'Stamp & Transfer Duty @ 4% if the donee is a woman and @ 6% if the donee is a man'; property must be valued by an approved valuer. Schedule I-A Art. 33 (Gift): 'The same duty as Conveyance (No.23) on the value of property.' Base = value of property (market value).

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH for male/female (official Delhi Dept. of Revenue: 6% male donee / 4% female donee on property value). Art. 33 charges gift at the same duty as Conveyance on the property value. OPEN QUESTIONS: (1) the official page states only male/female for gift — a 'joint' donee rate is NOT stated; not encoded (defaults to 6% for any non-female donee_category). Confirm if joint/other donee categories need distinct treatment. (2) Family-relation concessions (e.g. gift to specified relatives) may apply in Delhi — NOT encoded; confirm the Delhi relative list (PRD §5.5 requires per-state relative definitions, never generalized). (3) Confirm exact effective_from and rounding rule as per conveyance.
